text:
sanya: :rotating_light: na1 p99 spiked from ~300ms to ~1.9s around 14:12 UTC. Dashboard shows sustained batching queue and a spike in KV cache misses after a routing flapping event.
mira: which pools are impacted?
sanya: mostly n1-gpu-pool-03 and the edge NA1-rt nodes that serve short sequences. CPU on the router VMs jumped, connections churned -> duplicate prefixes hitting KV lookups.
jin: can you paste the slow trace sample?
sanya: trace excerpt: `req: model-x -> stalled at batcher.wait(200ms) -> kvcache.get(key) timeout -> fallback to slowpath`
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2148005678 by sanya. Pager duty notified.
mira: looks like a batching scheduling regression from yesterday's runtime push + router flaps caused a thundering miss pattern. Any recent runtime rollouts?
sanya: runtime v2.14.1 rolled at 13:40 (canary green) then scaled to 75% at 13:55.
jin: hypothesizing: change in scheduling heuristics increased pack wait for short-latency flows; combined w/ routing oscillation increased concurrent KV key misses -> hotspots.
taylor: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable continuous batching on affected pools 2) pin traffic to older runtime 3) increase kvcache replication factor 4) shift a portion of traffic to eu-west. Cost/latency tradeoffs?
mira: prefer target 1+4 to reduce risk and surface root cause. Disabling batching reduces throughput but should cut p99.
sanya: running command to flip batching flag on na1 pools (will take ~30s to propagate):
```
infractl patch pool na1 --selector n1-gpu-pool-03 --set continuous_batching=false --reason "emergency kvcache backoff"
```
ops-bot: Patch job started: job-2148005702. ETA propagation 45s.
oncall-rotation: shifting 12% of na1 traffic to eu-west as a safety valve. Doing gradual weight change.
jin: also increasing KV cache TTL for short prefixes to avoid immediate churn: `kvadm update prefix-ttl --ttl 90s --scope na1-short`
taylor: monitor token cost — if we move to eu-west outbound egress and higher replicas we inflate spend. Keep finance / infra-cost on watch.
sanya: patch job finished. early signals: p50 stable, p95 down from 1.2s -> 420ms, p99 improving but still above baseline.
mira: good. continue weight shift to eu-west up to 25% if p99 not back to baseline in 10m. Also open runtime rollback PR if we see same signature in traces after batching disabled.
jin: collecting heap/kv stats and packing them into the incident doc. If kvcache eviction rate remains high we'll consider raising cache capacity for na1 temporarily.
oncall-rotation: eu-west shift at 14:22 -> 25% now. No token auth issues seen.
sanya: after 8m, p99 stabilized ~450ms. No errors in model outputs.
taylor: document cost hit estimate in the incident: rough +18% GPU egress/replica cost if maintained; will revert once stable.
mira: follow-up actions: 1) revert runtime scheduling change in next patch 2) add circuit-breaker to routing to avoid oscillation 3) add kvcache pre-warming for short sequence keys 4) playbook updates for batching flip.
sanya: adding runbook entries and logs to INC-2148005678. Closing immediate mitigation; leaving incident open for RCA. :thumbsup:
